plain_description.what: Compares routing each question by its 50 nearest neighbours (within its own source corpus) with routing by the discovered cells of the label-free union tree, on about 5,900 evaluation questions. No calls.
plain_description.why: It asks whether cells add anything for routing over raw neighbourhoods.
plain_description.information: If neighbours did as well, cells would only matter for reporting. If cells did better, they would earn their routing role. Result: undetermined. The gap is +0.12 points with an interval of -1.2 to +1.4, so cells are neither shown to add nor shown unneeded. The result is source-conditioned (it uses the source corpus). The unrestricted neighbour comparison is descriptive only.
